subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw core define a stable per-user accounting subject and authorized per-user usage view now, or defer this until broader Gateway principal/accounting design exists?
rationale: Current usage telemetry and origin metadata are not enough for billing-grade per-user views, and exposing per-user cost/activity data crosses identity and authorization boundaries.

options.title: Define Core Accounting Subject
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved accounting subject and viewer-permission model before extending usage RPCs and UI around it.

options.title: Wait For Principal Design
options.body: Keep the issue open but block implementation until Gateway multi-principal and per-message author attribution semantics are settled.

options.title: External Reporting Only For Now
options.body: Document Prometheus/plugin exports as the supported path for custom spend dashboards until core has multi-user direction.

recommendation.title: Define Core Accounting Subject
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved accounting subject and viewer-permission model before extending usage RPCs and UI around it.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest observed history across provider usage tracking, `/usage` summaries, shared usage helpers, and the security-sensitive core boundary decision.
